why: The example file covers 3 of the 4 keys read, so it IS an inventory and a per-key verdict is earned. SEARCH_API_KEY is read and declared nowhere - uncertain, never unresolved, because real secrets live in a dashboard. LEGACY_MAILER_URL is declared and read by no source file - also UNCERTAIN, not unused: hand-verification across three repos scored 'declared but unread' at 0 for 20, because container images, shell scripts, schema parsers and CI all consume configuration without a process.env in a source file. That claim is not one source can earn.
